features: Heart Rate Tracking: View heart rate readings during workouts and everyday activity to review changes in activity intensity without relying on a separate tracking device
Daily Activity Tracking: Track steps, walking distance, calories and workout activity to review daily movement during walks, exercise sessions and regular routines
Sleep Tracking: Review available sleep information including deep sleep, light sleep and rest duration to understand your nightly activity patterns
Call and Message Alerts: Receive incoming call, SMS and app notifications on the band so you can check important alerts without repeatedly reaching for your phone
Multi-Activity Use: Use the band for walking, running, cycling, gym workouts, yoga, trekking and other everyday exercise routines
